name: SnagRelay – Intelligent Bug Capture
author: snagrelay

sections.description:
SnagRelay is an AI-powered bug reporting tool that captures everything developers need to fix issues fast — annotated screenshots, session replay, video recording, console logs, network activity, and AI-generated reproduction steps. This plugin installs the SnagRelay widget on your WordPress site in seconds, with no code required.

Reports land directly in your existing issue tracker. No separate board to check, no context switching.

WordPress plugin features

  • No-code installation — just enter your API token
  • Independently enable the widget on the frontend and/or the WP admin area
  • Control visibility by user role (everyone, logged-in users, or specific roles)
  • Filter by post type (all, pages, posts, or specific types)
  • Filter by post status (all, published, or drafts/pending)
  • Lightweight — loads asynchronously, zero performance impact
  • 14-day free trial, no credit card required

What SnagRelay captures

  • HD annotated screenshots
  • Session replay recording
  • 60-second screen video with auto-generated reproduction steps
  • Full console logs and error stack traces
  • Network requests and payloads
  • Browser metadata and environment details

AI intelligence

  • Automatic duplicate detection
  • Priority suggestions (P1–P5)
  • Smart assignee matching
  • Learns from your team’s decisions over time

Integrations

Sends reports directly to the tools your team already uses:

  • Jira
  • Linear
  • Trello
  • GitHub
  • Custom webhooks

External Services

This plugin connects to the SnagRelay service (https://app.snagrelay.com) to load the bug-capture widget and to transmit bug reports to your configured issue tracker.

What is sent and when:

  • When a page is loaded with the widget enabled, the plugin loads a script from https://app.snagrelay.com/widget/load/{api_token}. Your API token is included in this request so the service can identify your project.
  • When a user submits a bug report via the widget, SnagRelay collects and transmits the data selected by the user, which may include: annotated screenshots, session replay recording, screen video, console logs, network request details, browser metadata, and environment information.
  • No data is sent to the external service unless the widget is enabled and a valid API token is configured.

Service provider: SnagRelay (https://snagrelay.com)

  • Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/snagrelay, or install through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Settings → SnagRelay to configure the plugin.
  4. Enter your API token from your SnagRelay dashboard.
  5. Enable the widget on the frontend and/or admin as needed.
  6. Optionally configure user role, post type, and post status filters.
sections.faq:
Where do I get an API token?

Sign up at snagrelay.com — anyone can start a 14-day free trial with no credit card required. Your API token is available in your project dashboard.

Can I show the widget only to logged-in users or specific roles?

Yes. The Users setting lets you choose between everyone, authenticated users only, or specific WordPress roles such as Editor or Administrator.

Can I limit the widget to specific post types or page statuses?

Yes. You can restrict the widget to pages, posts, or specific post types, and further filter by published or draft/pending status.

Can I enable it only in the WordPress admin area?

Yes. The “Show in admin” toggle is independent of the frontend toggle, so you can run the widget on admin screens only, on the public site only, or on both.

Will it slow down my site?

No. The widget script is loaded asynchronously and does not block page rendering or affect your Core Web Vitals.

Does SnagRelay work on local and staging environments?

Yes. You can install the plugin on any environment — local, staging, or production.

How much does SnagRelay cost?

All plans include a 14-day free trial.
